cards.text: Jerusalem is in danger, and Jeremiah the prophet has been telling all the people what the LORD says about it. Four officials hear about it: Shephatiah, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jucal and Pashhur son of Malchijah. The message starts like this: whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague.

cards.question: Whoever stays in Jerusalem will die. So who does the LORD's message say will live?
Jeremiah also tells the people the LORD says the army of Babylon's king will never capture Jerusalem.

cards.text: So the officials go to Zedekiah, king of Judah, and say Jeremiah's words are discouraging the warriors left in the city and all the people too. Friend, that's yelling at the weatherman because it's RAINING.

cards.question: What do the officials tell King Zedekiah should happen to Jeremiah?
What does King Zedekiah tell the officials about Jeremiah?

cards.text: The king says he can do nothing to stop them. So they lower Jeremiah with ropes into the cistern of Malchiah, the king's son, in the courtyard of the guard.

cards.question: The cistern has no water in it, only ___, and Jeremiah sinks down into it.

cards.text: Then Ebed-melech the Cushite, a court official in the royal palace, hears what happened and goes out to the king at the Gate of Benjamin. The officials want Jeremiah dead, the king says he can't stop them, and ONE man steps up.

cards.question: Ebed-melech tells King Zedekiah that these men have acted wickedly in all they've done to Jeremiah.
Ebed-melech says Jeremiah will starve to death in that cistern. Why?

answers.text: There is no more bread in the city
The officials took away his food
The guards are not allowed to feed him

cards.question: King Zedekiah turns Ebed-melech down and leaves Jeremiah in the cistern.

cards.text: Instead, the king tells Ebed-melech to take thirty men and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies. Friend, THIRTY men for one prophet is not a rescue, it's a PARADE.

Ebed-melech grabs old rags and worn-out clothes from a place below the palace storehouse and lowers them with ropes to Jeremiah. Worn-out old stuff that sat down below finally gets called up for a big job, and after my years in the back of a junk drawer, friend, I KNOW that feeling.

cards.question: Ebed-melech calls down to Jeremiah to put the rags and worn-out clothes under his arms. Why?

answers.text: To keep warm in the mud

cards.question: Once they pull Jeremiah up out of the cistern, he is set free from the courtyard of the guard.

cards.text: Then King Zedekiah sends for Jeremiah the prophet and meets him at the third entrance to the house of the LORD. He's got a question, and he tells Jeremiah, "Do not hide anything from me."

cards.question: Jeremiah says that if he answers King Zedekiah's question, something will happen to him. What?

answers.text: The king will surely put him to death
The king will throw him back in the cistern
The king will send him off to Babylon

cards.text: Jeremiah adds that even if he gives the king advice, the king won't listen to him. But Zedekiah swears to him in secret, as surely as the LORD lives.

cards.question: What does King Zedekiah secretly swear to Jeremiah?

answers.text: He will not kill him or hand him over
He will send him away from the city
He will do whatever the LORD says

cards.text: So Jeremiah gives him the word of the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel. It's an if-then, and the first choice is surrender.

cards.question: If King Zedekiah surrenders to the officers of Babylon's king, the LORD says he will live and the city will not be ___.
If Zedekiah refuses to surrender, the LORD says he himself will still escape the Chaldeans' grasp.

cards.text: But Zedekiah has a fear. He says the Chaldeans may hand him over to some people who will abuse him.

cards.question: Who does King Zedekiah tell Jeremiah he's afraid of?

answers.text: The Jews who deserted to the Chaldeans
The prophets who spoke against Jeremiah

cards.question: Jeremiah tells King Zedekiah the Chaldeans will not hand him over to those deserters.

cards.text: Jeremiah tells Zedekiah to obey the voice of the LORD, so it may go well with him and he may live. But if he refuses to surrender, the LORD has shown Jeremiah what comes next.
All the women left in the palace of Judah's king will be brought out to Babylon's officials. Those women will have something to say about Zedekiah's trusted friends.

cards.question: The palace women say that when Zedekiah's feet sank into the mire, his trusted friends ___ him.
Jeremiah says that if Zedekiah refuses, his wives and children will be brought out to the Chaldeans.

cards.text: Then Zedekiah warns Jeremiah, "Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you will die." Friend, most "just between us" talks end with "or I'll be upset," not THAT.

cards.question: If the officials demand to know what Jeremiah and the king talked about, what does Zedekiah tell Jeremiah to say?

answers.text: He asked not to be sent back to Jonathan's house to die
He came to report to the king on the officials' plans
He came to pray for the king and the people of the city

cards.question: The officials question Jeremiah, and he gives them the exact words the king told him to say. Why do they say no more to him?

answers.text: No one had overheard the conversation
The king ordered them to leave him alone
They feared what the people might do

cards.question: Jeremiah remains in the courtyard of the guard until the day Jerusalem is ___.

cards.text: We're stopping here, friend, but don't take your apron off. This story is still in the oven.
